decisions.reason: As the flagship cloud transactional email service, it fits the firm's strategic direction and the growing demand for cloud messaging, so the option is worth further commitment.
Document capture supports the firm's push into electronic document workflows, which has gained momentum with digitalization, and keeping it on its existing platform costs little.
Email-to-fax conversion still serves regulated customers such as healthcare and public institutions at low marginal cost, though the long-term decline of fax adds some risk of withdrawal.
This feature sits close to the core fax service and costs almost nothing to maintain, but it could be folded into the base offer as fax volumes decline.
Rising ransomware and phishing threats make sandbox protection more valuable to the security portfolio, especially after the multi-engine scanner was dropped, so the option should stay open.
